One file: the app, its local server, and the computer bridge.\n\n  Run the built app, or from source:\n      pip install -r requirements.txt\n      python chandra.py                 # opens in its own window\n      python chandra.py --allow-shell   # also let Chandra run shell commands\n      python chandra.py "C:\\path\\memory.ananta"   # open a memory file on launch\n\nThe whole Chandra UI, a local server for it, and the computer bridge live in this one file.\nPyAutoGUI drives the real mouse and keyboard; Pillow captures the screen. Chandra can: screenshot,\nscreen_text (OCR), mouse_move, click, drag, scroll, type_text, press_keys, open_app, open_url,\nclipboard, window list/focus, system info, volume, brightness, power (with on-screen confirm),\nfiles under your home, web fetch/search, and run_shell (only with --allow-shell).\n\nSafety, unchanged: 127.0.0.1 only; the app URL carries a private pairing code and every bridge\nrequest must present it; routine actions run without a question, and sensitive ones (risk_of) ask in the chat first (Allow, Deny, Stop); "Stop all"\nhalts Chandra; and throwing the mouse into any screen corner aborts\nPyAutoGUI instantly.  Keep this file private once it is yours.\n\nThe brain (new in 1.1): the page holds no API key.
